name: Canaria-Phase3B-stronger-teacher-regression-confirmatory-v1

data.normalization: features and target standardized from training subset only
data.external_validity_boundary: fresh model seeds on one reused built-in dataset/split; not eight datasets and not an operationally unseen test set

architecture: input->Linear64+GELU->4 residual MLP blocks (LayerNorm, Linear128, GELU, Linear64)->Linear1

replacement.learned_parameter_budget: component-wise=256*h and composed=256*h at every grid point
replacement.validation_selection: first grid point with span NMSE <= 0.12 and validation R2 >= selected-teacher validation R2 - 0.05

numeric_profile.role: prospectively adopted from separately validated R87D7 portability work; this is a new execution recipe, not historical Phase3 numeric reproduction
numeric_profile.adamw_sqrt_intervention: only float32 Tensor.sqrt calls inside AdamW.step are evaluated in float64 then cast back to float32; parameters, optimizer moments, activations and losses remain their original dtypes
numeric_profile.scope: CPU eager isolated-process experiment; not a universal GPU, torch.compile, multi-thread or hardware theorem

H.teacher: The validation-selected short_25 teacher is materially stronger than the old baseline_60 teacher on fresh seeds and has useful held-out test R2.
H.composition: With that stronger teacher, composed-span replacement still selects a smaller validation-passing learned-parameter budget than matched component-wise replacement while selected test R2 is noninferior within 0.05 R2.

statistics.method: paired model-seed percentile bootstrap using one shared index matrix for all paired means

decision_rules.integrity: all eight fresh seeds retained; both replacement endpoints required for all eight. Missing, malformed, nonfinite or unselected endpoint => STOP_INTEGRITY_OR_CENSORING; never replace/drop a seed.
decision_rules.teacher_absolute: PASS iff lower95 of mean short_25 teacher test R2 > 0.20; FAIL iff upper95 <= 0.20; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
decision_rules.teacher_improvement: PASS iff lower95 of paired (short_25 - baseline_60) teacher test R2 > 0.05; FAIL iff upper95 <= 0.05; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
decision_rules.composition_budget: PASS iff composed budget is strictly lower in at least 7/8 seeds AND upper95 of mean log2(B_composed/B_componentwise) < 0; FAIL if all endpoints exist and either criterion fails.
decision_rules.selected_utility: PASS iff lower95 of paired selected-endpoint test R2 difference (composed - component-wise) > -0.05; FAIL iff upper95 <= -0.05; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
decision_rules.overall: PHASE3B_CONFIRMATORY_PASS iff integrity is complete and teacher_absolute, teacher_improvement, composition_budget and selected_utility all PASS. Otherwise report the exact failing/uncertain gates without rescue.

test_policy: Teacher test R2 is a prospectively locked Stage B confirmation/safeguard after Stage A selected the recipe using validation only. Replacement test metrics are evaluated only for validation-selected endpoints and never choose budgets.
technical_replication: A second hosted execution may repeat all eight seeds under the same numeric profile; technical repetitions do not increase independent scientific n and must be compared exactly rather than pooled.
C: Stage A validation improvement may not transfer to held-out test R2.
A stronger teacher may make the replacement criterion harder and remove the apparent composition advantage.
The new numerical profile can alter exact endpoints relative to old Phase3; old outcomes remain historical rather than being overwritten.
U: One fixed diabetes dataset/split limits external validity.
The same residual-MLP family is used, so this tests task change more than architecture change.
Selected budgets are minima only over the locked finite grid, not mathematical minima.
No runtime, memory, energy or universal regression claim follows.
stopping_rule: Run seeds 2400-2407 exactly once after protocol and implementation preflight. No threshold/grid/recipe change, seed replacement, rescue condition, cohort expansion or optional stopping after outcomes.
